newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Telesis Q3 access lines up 4.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Telesis Q3 access lines up 4.4 pct.

text.p: Pacific Telesis Group Thursday said the number of total access lines in service rose 4.4 percent in the third quarter ended in September.

In a statement accompanying the telephone company's third quarter financial results, Pacific Telesis said the third quarter total access line growth rate was even with the second quarter's revised 4.4 percent increase and up slightly from a revised 3.7 percent growth rate in the first quarter of 1996.
Business access lines rose 5.7 percent in the third quarter while residential access lines rose 3.8 percent.
"Sales of additional lines for home offices, Internet access, and data communications services continued their year- long trend of very strong growth," the company said.
"Through September, the number of additional lines has increased by 105 percent over the last year."
